articles.summary: Business Wire: Pfizer’s ELREXFIO Significantly Improves Progression-Free Survival for Double-Class Exposed Patients with Relapsed or Refractory Multiple Myeloma. NEW YORK, April 29, 2026--Pfizer Inc. (NYSE: PFE) today announced positive topline results from the Phase 3 MagnetisMM-5 study evaluating ELREXFIO® (elranatamab) as monotherapy in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM) who received at least one prior line of treatment.
